name: braindash
description: Local command-center dashboard over an Obsidian vault (read-only)

scripts.dev:https: concurrently -k -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm:dev:server" "npm run dev:https -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w server && npm run test:coverage -w web
